data_fields.name: starting_grant
data_fields.donor_constant: STARTING_BALANCE_CENTS = 10_000 cents ($100.00), granted once per identity on first connection

data_fields.name: balance_ceiling
data_fields.donor_constant: MAX_U64 = (1n << 64n) - 1n; recipient balance may not exceed ceiling minus amount

data_fields.name: min_transfer
data_fields.donor_constant: amount must be non-zero (1 cent minimum)

best_idea: A zero-sum transfer that checks every rule first (funds, self, zero, overflow), then writes both balances and two audit rows, so a refused call changes nothing and every change can be read back per account.
decision_why: Take the two-row audit ledger and check-all-then-write order (the one-ledger shape we want); add a request id for retries from the benchmark answer and make the starting grant a capped data field, not an open grant per new identity.
acceptance: A server test: alice (100.00) pays bob 40.00 under request r1, leaving alice 60.00 and bob 40.00 with one Debit and one Credit row; the same r1 again changes nothing; a 1000.00 payment is refused and writes no rows; a self-payment is refused.
